notes.title: MiniBotz v4.1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Whats New:[/h1]
[list]
[*]All levels have had their lighting changed and improved.
[*]Included Black Hole and Radiation power ups back to Chaos mode but not Control mode.
[*]Updated title menu background images to reflect changes in each level's lighting.
[*]Updated some navigation meshes
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Corrected a bug where the game would spike the cpu and crash the game.
[*]Corrected a bug where if both players choose Gizmo in Chaos mode, player two would not receive points.
[*]Removed physics interpolation for all rigid body assets to reduce performance hit due to a bug inside the Unity Engine.
[*]Improved Ai algorithm for capturing flags.
[*]Corrected a bug where two Clips on the same level would cause a frame drop.
[/list]

As always, please report any bugs that you find on our Steam App Discussion page at http://steamcommunity.com/app/508520/discussions/1/

notes.title: MiniBotz v4.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Whats New:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added new Control Mode
[b]Control mode has several new features not seen in MiniBotz before. This includes challenging AI, and capturing spawn points![/b]
[*]Added more music tracks.
[*]Added the ability of the game to choose a random music track when the previous one is finished.
[*]Expanded the size of all play levels so now more area is available to play in!
[*]Added new texture sets to specific objects in the game. [b]Can all the hidden easter eggs be found?[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed the ability of the player to rotate their bot when the game is paused.
[*]Updated and re-baked all navmeshes in all levels. (How the AI knows where to move)
[*]Optimized and corrected targeting for enemies.
[*]Several stability fixes. The rate that the game crashes to desktop or freezes should be now significantly reduced.
[*]Corrected some typos in the menu system text fields.
[/list]

As always, please report any bugs that you find on our Steam App Discussion page at http://steamcommunity.com/app/508520/discussions/1/

notes.content:

[list]
[*]Reduced BoomCube damage.
[*]Reduced difficulty scaling effect on enemies in Survival mode.
[*]Improved pathfinding for enemies when a bot is in the air by jumping.

[list]
[*]Added new enemy type, BoomCubez!
[*]Added scaling difficulty to Survival mode.
[*]New Bot, Carmine!
[*]Added new revive mechanic.
[/list]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed enemy select from Survival mode.
[*]Changed Survival mode so that all enemies appear in the mode at once in wave patterns.
[*]Controls have been improved.
[*]Adjusted stat numbers for botz and enemies.
[/list]

Please report any bugs that you find on our Steam App Discussion page at http://steamcommunity.com/app/508520/discussions/1/

notes.title: MiniBotz v3.0.18
notes.content:
Another set of minor fixes today, we are currently looking into some multiplayer solutions and have found one that is working so far.  No release date yet on multiplayer, but it is definitely being looked at.

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Game Over screen now displays high scores.
[*]Fixed a bug where the game over screen did not display at the end of versus mode.
[*]Mack's attack radius has been toned down.
[*]Bit's normal attack special effect has been toned down.
[*]Health special effect has been toned down.
[*]Fixed fullscreen toggle, the toggle button now reflects the correct state regardless of what mode the player is in.
[*]Increased damage on the danger zones (the floor and small holes like in the couch) to reflect the increase of hit points on the bots.
[*]Smoke effect for when a bot is slowed down has been brightened.
[*]Adjusted height of stove range to allow easier access to powerup and prevent rocket powerup from exploding on top
[/list]

Please report any bugs that you find on our Steam App Discussion page at http://steamcommunity.com/app/508520/discussions/1/

notes.title: MiniBotz v3.0.12 1-30-17
notes.content:
[h1]The PAX Build[/h1]
Thank you all who visited us at PAX for your input, the v3.0.12 build incorporates many of your ideas and suggestions! Please make sure to leave us a comment if you enjoyed the build or have a suggestion!
 
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Implemented new control scheme where the right stick automatically fires when pressed in the direction you want to fire in. This was a huge hit with the attendees at the show so this control scheme will be the direction we go forward in starting now.
[*]All Bit's and Gizmo's regular attacks now use the special attack graphics instead of the regular attacks. Both could not be seen so they were replaced with a better attack that are far more visible.
[*]As a result of the above change, Bit and Gizmo both had their SP attack graphics updated to something far more exaggerated. This was a big hit with attendees, hence this will be a permanent change, excluding tweaks that need to be implemented.
[*]The radiation spawn is now more visible, spawning as a large field. This helps increase the chance of irradiating the enemies or player when they pass through that field.
[*]Added a reticule that attaches to the player as a test to see if we can eventually get the rockets to follow the player instead of being stationary. This will be discussed more on Wednesday.
[*]Added a hot fix to the character select bug so now if player two activates their slot, the bot is already selected. We need to fix the code for the menu system in general so this change will not be kept in the long run, its only temporary
[*]Health on all bots have been increased by at least 25 percent. This allows newer players to stay alive slightly longer so they can figure out the controls.
[*]Damage to the radiation effect has been slightly increased, before the damage was too low to kill any enemies so it was slightly buffed to the point where it still takes time to kill a bot but its also enough damage to kill an enemy after a few seconds.
[*]Both bumpers are now jump buttons due to moving fire to the right stick. The function of the right bumper in the future may be changed, this will be discussed on Wednesday.
[*]Spawn rates for power ups have been increased so that they spawn more often. The previous rate was still too infrequent after several sessions of testing from developers and attendees.
[/list]
 
Please report any bugs that you find on our Steam App Discussion page at [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/508520/discussions/1/]http://steamcommunity.com/app/508520/discussions/1/[/url]

[*]Health on all bots have been increased by at least 25 percent. This allows newer players to stay alive slightly longer so they can figure out the controls.
[*]Damage to the radiation effect has been slightly increased, before the damage was too low to kill any enemies so it was slightly buffed to the point where it still takes time to kill a bot but its also enough damage to kill an enemy after a few seconds.
[*]Both bumpers are now jump buttons due to moving fire to the right stick. The function of the right bumper in the future may be changed, this will be discussed on Wednesday.
[*]Spawn rates for power ups have been increased so that they spawn more often. The previous rate was still too infrequent after several sessions of testing from developers and attendees.
[/list]
 
Please report any bugs that you find on our Steam App Discussion page at [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/508520/discussions/1/]http://steamcommunity.com/app/508520/discussions/1/[/url]

notes.title: MiniBotz v3.0.5 1-25-17
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]We've added a custom splash screen
[*]Fixed an issue that stopped the game from pausing while on a menu.
[*]"Quit" now takes you to the main menu, instead of the title screen.
[*]There is a new camera that is closer to bots, makes gameplay more intense and you can see everything better.
[*]HUDS were moved to the bottom. I'm not sure if they were still in the corners.
[*]There is a respawn delay and particle effect on death.
[*]The spawn chance of positive buffs were doubled when grabbing a "Random" powerup, to incentivize pickup. As a result the negative powerup chance is now halved.
[*]Mack SP attack nerfed to 55.
[*]Bit and Gizmo movement increased to 3.3. Mack increased to 4. Clip increased to 5.
[*]Gizmo SP blades nerfed from 20dmg each to 15dmg each, but given a larger collider for more consistent hits than the base attack.
[*]Bit now has 155 Hp instead of 100
[*]Clip now has 110 Hp instead of 100
[*]Gizmo now has 135 Hp instead of 100
[*]Mack now has 220 Hp instead of 200
[*]Bit's direct attack now does 30 dmg instead of 60.
[*]Clip's base attack was reduced to 1 from 2.
[*]The speed of enemies was increased from 2.25 to 3.5.
[*]General fixes
[/list]
 
[h1]Issues:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Damage on hot plate needs to be re-implemented.
[*]Overheal is still occurring with the health pickup. Need to investigate and correct.
[*]Picking up the Attack Special powerup, with any bot, plays the "Bit Special Laser" sound.
[*]After picking up the Speed Up powerup and it expends itself, the bot SOMETIMES maintains the same speed boost.
[*]Character select hex icon for player 2 still needs investigated, it is still acting as if it is selected when player 2 hits the A button.
[*]Overheal is still occurring with the health pickup.
[*]Mack cannot damage Mack, if more than one player picks that bot in Versus.
[/list]
